text.tspan: 1 · VIDEO AMPLIFIER — mixer IF in, sound-card line out. Probe TP_IF TP_AP TP_AOUT TP_BOUT TP_LP TP_AUDIO
V_IF: Multisim AC_VOLTAGE. 10 mVpk for the low-gain build,
0.5 mVpk for full gain (it clips at 10 mV). Bode: AC sweep 1 Hz-100 kHz
mixer IF source impedance
gain A = 1 + R3/R4 = 101 (R4 = 4.7k -> 22, first power-up)
gain B = 1 + R7/R8 = 11 (R7 = wire link -> 1)
R12/C9: 15.9 kHz low-pass
R_LOAD = sound-card line input
(or drive VREF from frame 2)
EXPECTED low gain (R4 4.7k, R7 link): 10 mVpk in -> 107 mVpk at TP_AUDIO
full gain: 54.6 dB from V_IF at 1 kHz, -6 dB at 159 Hz, -3 dB at 15.9 kHz; clips at +/-4.1 V
radar input 8 mV @ 12.5 Hz + 40 uV @ 417 Hz -> TP_AUDIO 27 mV leak, 19 mV echo
U1A/U1B/U2B = TL072CP (Multisim: Analog > OPAMP > TL072CP)
2 · HALF-RAIL REFERENCE — VREF = VANA/2 buffered
ripple test: + 100 mVpk 150 kHz
R_LOAD = the six VREF returns
EXPECTED TP_VDIV 5.70 V, TP_VREF 5.70 V, ripple at TP_VREF < 1 uV
3 · 12 V INPUT — D1 -> VPROT -> R15/C13 -> VANA
ripple test: + 100 mVpk 150 kHz; reverse test: -12 V
60 R = the LM2596 drawing 0.2 A
1.1k = two TL072 + dividers
EXPECTED TP_VPROT 11.7 V, TP_VANA 11.6 V, ripple 4 mVpp;
with V_IN = -12 V: TP_VPROT -0.1 mV, 2 uA
4 · SYNC DIVIDER — ESP32 GPIO -> 0.3 V -> sound-card R
6.4 ms high, 7.4 ms period, 10 ns edges
GPIO output R
C_CPL / R_SC = the sound card's AC-coupled input
EXPECTED TP_SYNC 283 mV high / 0 V low;
TP_SC +201 mV drooping / -100 mV retrace pulse -> software detects EDGES
5 · THE RADAR ITSELF, SCALED — chirp x delayed chirp = beat. Carrier cancels, so B/10 and delay x10 give the real 417 Hz
R12/C9 = the amp's 15.9 kHz LP; C1/R2, C2/R6 = its two 159 Hz HPs (they kill the leakage tone)
Multisim parts: PIECEWISE_LINEAR_VOLTAGE -> VOLTAGE_CONTROLLED_SINE_WAVE; LOSSLESS_LINE_TYPE1; VOLTAGE_GAIN_BLOCK; VOLTAGE_SUMMER; MULTIPLIER
Transient: TMAX 10 ns, stop 19.2 ms (3 chirps). Fourier at TP_BEAT over ONE chirp (6.4 ms), Hanning window.
EXPECTED leakage gain x0: peak at 417 Hz, 4.5 mV. TD1 = 333 ns -> 208 Hz. TD1 = 1.33 us -> 833 Hz (20 m).
Leakage gain x1: the 417 Hz line is unchanged but the spectrum floor rises 20 dB near DC - what chirp-to-chirp subtraction removes in software.
Real radar: B = 40 MHz, TD = 66.7 ns (10 m), T = 6.4 ms -> f_beat = B x TD / T = 417 Hz. Here: B = 4 MHz, TD = 667 ns. Same answer.
The blocks right of the mixer's IF port cannot be simulated in Multisim (no 2.4 GHz models): ADF4351, SPF5189Z, splitter, mixer, horns are measured, not modelled.
PARTS resistors 1 % 1/4 W · 100n / 10n film or C0G · 10u 47u 100u electrolytic 25 V (+ marked) · 1N5822 · TL072CP x3 · single 12 V rail
Netlists that produced the EXPECTED lines: hardware/spice/*.cir (ngspice 42). Same values as the breadboard sheet radar_breadboard.kicad_sch.
